<shell skill_resources="3d-dna/tad-calling#scripts/call_tads.py">
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

LEAF="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/03.三维基因组/00.data/Matrix/Final/leaf.mcool"
BUD="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/03.三维基因组/00.data/Matrix/Final/bud.mcool"
RESOLUTION=40000

# Verify both input files exist and are readable
if [ ! -f "$LEAF" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: leaf.mcool not found: $LEAF" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$BUD" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: bud.mcool not found: $BUD" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# List available resolutions in both mcool files and confirm 40000 is present
echo "Available resolutions in leaf.mcool:"
conda run -n hicexplore python -c "import cooler; print(cooler.fileops.list_coolers('$LEAF'))"

echo "Available resolutions in bud.mcool:"
conda run -n hicexplore python -c "import cooler; print(cooler.fileops.list_coolers('$BUD'))"

# Confirm resolution 40000 is available in both files
LEAF_RES=$(conda run -n hicexplore python -c "import cooler; print($RESOLUTION in cooler.fileops.list_coolers('$LEAF'))")
BUD_RES=$(conda run -n hicexplore python -c "import cooler; print($RESOLUTION in cooler.fileops.list_coolers('$BUD'))")

if [ "$LEAF_RES" != "True" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: resolution $RESOLUTION not found in leaf.mcool" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ "$BUD_RES" != "True" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: resolution $RESOLUTION not found in bud.mcool" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Both leaf.mcool and bud.mcool exist, are readable, and contain resolution $RESOLUTION"

# Emit structured observation evidence
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
evidence = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "produces_observations": [
        {
            "identity": "input_resolutions_confirmed",
            "value": {
                "leaf_mcool": "/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/03.三维基因组/00.data/Matrix/Final/leaf.mcool",
                "bud_mcool": "/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/03.三维基因组/00.data/Matrix/Final/bud.mcool",
                "resolution_bp": 40000,
                "leaf_exists": True,
                "bud_exists": True,
                "leaf_resolution_available": True,
                "bud_resolution_available": True
            }
        }
    ]
}
print("BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON=" + json.dumps(evidence))
PY
</shell>
